description: This file contains functions for exporting various Mattermost data structures into a common import format, including teams, channels, users, posts, reactions, roles, schemes, and thread followers.

methods.name: importLineFromTeam
methods.description: Converts a TeamForExport object into an import line data structure.

methods.name: importLineFromChannel
methods.description: Converts a ChannelForExport object into an import line data structure.

methods.name: importLineFromDirectChannel
methods.description: Converts a DirectChannelForExport object into an import line data structure, including participants and optional favorited/shown by info.

methods.name: importDirectChannelMembersFromChannelMembers
methods.description: Transforms channel members into import data, including notification preferences.

methods.name: importLineFromUser
methods.description: Converts a User object into an import line, including preferences.

methods.name: importLineFromBot
methods.description: Converts a Bot object into an import line with owner info.

methods.name: importUserTeamDataFromTeamMember
methods.description: Creates team membership data with roles for a user.

methods.name: importUserChannelDataFromChannelMemberAndPreferences
methods.description: Creates channel membership data with roles, notification preferences, and favorite status.

methods.name: importLineForPost
methods.description: Converts a PostForExport object into an import line.

methods.name: importLineForDirectPost
methods.description: Converts a DirectPostForExport object into an import line.

methods.name: importReplyFromPost
methods.description: Converts a ReplyForExport object into an import reply data structure.

methods.name: importReactionFromPost
methods.description: Creates a reaction import data structure from user and reaction info.

methods.name: importLineFromEmoji
methods.description: Converts an Emoji object into an import line with image path.

methods.name: importRoleDataFromRole
methods.description: Creates role import data from a Role object.

methods.name: importLineFromRole
methods.description: Wraps role data into an import line.

methods.name: importLineFromScheme
methods.description: Converts a Scheme object into an import line, including default roles based on scope.

methods.name: importFollowerFromThreadMember
methods.description: Creates thread follower data from thread membership info.
